subject: Hand your brain to WhatsApp; the mobile will report on your mental status
alt: Satish Acharya's cartoon: on the left a bearded man in a yellow kurta leans forward, eyes wide and a broad grin on his face, holding out a pink brain in his cupped hands, its veins showing. On the right stands an old man with a white beard, large glasses and a saffron shawl over pale yellow clothes; with both hands he holds a tablet sideways towards the other man, its blue screen carrying the green WhatsApp logo. A speech bubble from the old man says: PLACE IT HERE, MOBILE WILL GIVE A REPORT ON YOUR MENTAL STATUS! The cartoonist's signature, SATISH ACHARYA, is at the lower left.
chutki: A man steps forward with his brain in his hands, and the old man in the saffron shawl holds out a blue WhatsApp screen and says: place it here, the mobile will give a report on your mental status!

The needle is that thinking will now be done by the phone. Deposit the brain, the forwards will come, and the app will decide whether you are sane or ‘dimagi’. In an age when anyone asking for evidence is called mentally ill, the machine will issue the report - and we will happily deposit our brains in it.
